function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_system_rules
function.description: Retrieve a list of all system rules applicable for custom event specifications. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_type.description: The type of event for which the system rules are requested, such as 'conference', 'webinar', or 'workshop'.

include_inactive.description: A flag to indicate whether to include inactive rules in the result set.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_built_in_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of all built-in event specifications using their unique identifiers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

ids.description: A list of unique identifiers for the built-in event specifications.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_event_specification_infos_by_ids
function.description: Retrieve details of both built-in and custom event specifications using their unique identifiers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_ids.description: A list of event specification IDs for which details are requested. Each ID should be a unique string identifier.

include_custom.description: A flag indicating whether to include custom event specifications in the result. Defaults to true.

include_built_in.description: A flag indicating whether to include built-in event specifications in the result. Defaults to true.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_event_specification_infos
function.description: Retrieve a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications in the system. This includes details such as event names, identifiers, and types. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

include_built_in.description: Indicates whether to include built-in event specifications in the summary.

include_custom.description: Indicates whether to include custom event specifications in the summary.

search_term.description: Optional search term to filter the event specifications by name or identifier.

page_size.description: The number of event specifications to return per page.

page_number.description: The page number to retrieve, based on the pagination of the results.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_custom_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of all custom event specifications configured in the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

page.description: The page number of the results to fetch, starting from 1.

page_size.description: The number of results per page. Maximum value can vary by system configuration.

search_term.description: A keyword to filter the results based on event names or descriptions.

active_only.description: A flag to retrieve only active event specifications.
